components.name: FlowChart
components.description:
OXP "gated decision flow" — a timeline-headed Sankey/decision diagram.
A top timeline lists gates (cyan eyebrow + title + UTC time) over a divider
with red-triangle alert markers; dark translucent decision nodes are linked
by thick gradient ribbons (teal pass / red fail) carrying circular count
badges and mid-ribbon category pills. Fully token-driven.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed drawing height in px. Defaults to 460.

components.name: MeterChart
components.description:
Linear gradient health meter. The default "bar" variant mirrors the
severity-bar visual language; the "score" variant reproduces the OXP
Health-Score panel. Both gain a glow under IoC themes.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value plotted by the marker.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the numeric value on the right of the header.

props.name: height
props.description: Track height in px.

props.name: colors
props.description:
Gradient stops [low, mid, high]. Defaults to red → amber → cyan from
theme accent/semantic tokens.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats the displayed value.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout variant. "bar" (default) renders the compact gradient bar with a
dot marker. "score" renders the OXP Health-Score layout: a large
light-weight value, an uppercase caption, a gradient-outlined hint pill
and a hairline rainbow track with thin vertical value markers.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit appended to the value (e.g. "%").

props.name: title
props.description: Uppercase caption beneath the big value (score variant).

props.name: hint
props.description: Gradient-outlined helper pill text (score variant).

props.name: markers
props.description: Vertical value markers along the track (score variant).

props.name: gradientStops
props.description:
Full multi-stop rainbow for the score track, e.g.
red → magenta → orange → amber → green → cyan. Defaults to theme tokens.

props.name: cta
props.description: Optional call-to-action button (score variant).

components.name: NetworkChart
components.description:
Force-directed agent/tool network graph (OXP "agent network"). Layout is
computed with d3-force and rendered as SVG: purple glowing nodes, a red
error node, translucent links and Inter labels over a glass surface.

props.name: legend
props.description: Categorized legend groups rendered to the left of the graph.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Show text labels next to nodes. Defaults to true.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height (px) of the graph canvas. Defaults to 520.

props.name: interactive
props.description:
Enable drag, hover-highlight and tooltips with a live force simulation.
Defaults to true. When false, a static pre-computed layout is rendered.

components.name: SpiderChart
components.description:
Spider charts, also known as radar charts or star plots, are used to display multivariate data in a two-dimensional chart.
Each variable is represented by an axis radiating from a common center point, and the values of the variables are plotted as data points along the corresponding axis.
The range of values in a spider chart depends on the specific variables being represented.
